name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-decimal-as-byte-union-3055-p.bal
spec_references: Expressions / Literal: Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: The test expects a panic when a decimal value of 3055.0, boxed in Employee|string|decimal, is cast to byte|Employee. Type definitions, function calls, numeric literals, local declarations and type casts are supported, with no restriction excluding record/union types or failed numeric casts. The asserted failure of the union cast is within supported type-cast behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected failure at the cast; no particular error text is asserted.
